bio.text: Judy Chu was elected to the U.S. House in July 2009 and represents California's 28th Congressional District, which includes Pasadena and the west San Gabriel Valley.

Her House website says she was first elected to the Garvey School District Board of Education in 1985, then served on the Monterey Park City Council (where she served as mayor three times), in the State Assembly, and on the State Board of Equalization.
She was born in Los Angeles and earned a B.A. from UCLA in 1974 and a Ph.D. from the California School of Professional Psychology in 1979.
Before holding office she worked as a professor at Los Angeles City College and East Los Angeles College.
She is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
